headword: {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}

definitions.gloss: consultation counter; inquiry desk; help desk
definitions.explanation: A service counter or contact point where people can seek advice, ask questions, or get help with procedures. Found at government offices, hospitals, banks, and other institutions.

examples.japanese: {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go to the consultation counter.

examples.japanese: {市|し}{役所|やくしょ}の{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}で{手続|てつづ}きについて{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I asked about the procedures at the city hall consultation counter.

examples.japanese: {消費者|しょうひしゃ}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}に{苦情|くじょう}を{申|もう}し{出|で}た。
examples.english: I filed a complaint at the consumer consultation counter.

notes:
A compound of {相談|そうだん} (consultation) and {窓口|まどぐち} (counter/window). This is a frequently encountered term in Japanese bureaucratic and institutional contexts. Many government offices, hospitals, and companies have dedicated consultation counters for specific topics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire at the consultation counter
- {相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}を{設|もう}ける: to set up a consultation counter
- {無料|むりょう}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: free consultation counter
- {電話|でんわ}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: telephone consultation line

COMMON TYPES:
- {消費者|しょうひしゃ}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: consumer advice desk
- {税務|ぜいむ}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: tax consultation desk
- {法律|ほうりつ}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: legal consultation desk
- {外国人|がいこくじん}{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}: foreign residents' help desk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受付|うけつけ}: reception desk — a general-purpose reception counter
- {案内所|あんないじょ}: information desk — provides directions and general information
